summary: Evaluates a per-entry constraint force condition: selects a field-vector base on this (this+3464, or this+4484 when a3 is nonzero), computes (v[a2*4+920] - v[a2*4+96]) * v[a2*4+64] - input[a2], and returns 0 when the result is <= 0.34999999. Otherwise it records the outcome into the dword_7D1490 grid at index 216*a3 + 27*a2 (1056964608, i.e. float 0.5, when input[a2] >= 0.075000003, else 0) and returns 1.

operations.description: Select the field-vector base for this: default this+3464, switched to this+4484 when a3 is nonzero.

Load three a2-indexed floats from the selected base (offsets +920, +96, +64 with a2 scaling by 4) and combine as (v[a2*4+920] - v[a2*4+96]) * v[a2*4+64]; the comparison thresholds are folded from read-only float globals flt_59E458 and flt_59EF78.
Subtract the per-entry float at a4 + 4*a2 from the combined product.
If the resulting value is <= 0.34999999, return 0 (constraint considered satisfied).
Write into the dword_7D1490 grid at index 216*a3 + 27*a2: the value 1056964608 (0x3F000000, float 0.5) when the a4 + 4*a2 float is >= 0.075000003, otherwise 0.
